nodes.procedure: The commercial Ni foam (2 × 2 cm²) substrates were ultrasonically washed with HCl (4.0 M) for 30 min and subsequently dried in a vacuum.
nodes.source_text: the commercial Ni foam (2 × 2 cm²) substrates were ultrasonically washed with HCl (4.0 M) for 30 min and subsequently dried in a vacuum.

nodes.name: LMN solvothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: For LMN catalysts, stoichiometric amounts of La(NO3)3·6H2O (0.9 mmol), Sr(NO3)2 (0.1 mmol), Co(NO3)2·6H2O (1 mmol) and dispersed Ti3C2Tx MXene powders (50 mg) were dissolved in deionized water (20 mL) with methyl alcohol (20 mL), followed by adding an adequate amount of KOH to adjust pH of the precursor solution to pH 10. After that, the pretreated Ni foam was immersed in the above solution for hydrothermal reaction at 200°C for 48 h and followed by freeze-drying to form the composite.

nodes.characterization_summary: LMN possesses a hexagonal phase with R-3m space group confirmed by Rietveld refinement of XRD pattern.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Rietveld refinement of the XRD pattern further revealed that the LMN possessed a hexagonal phase with an R-3m space group (Figure 1b)

nodes.characterization_summary: LMN composite revealed distinctive porous nanosheets with pore sizes of several nanometers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM images of the La0.9Sr0.1CoO3/Ti3C2Tx MXene/NF (LMN) composite revealed distinctive porous nanosheets with pore sizes of several nanometers (Figure 1c,d)

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images verified the porous structure of LMN nanosheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM images verified the porous structure of nanosheets (Figure 1e)

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM images demonstrated lattice fringes with interplanar distances of 0.27 nm and 0.19 nm corresponding to (110) and (024) crystal planes of LSC1.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM images demonstrated two different lattice fringes with interplanar distances of 0.27 and 0.19 nm, corresponding to the (110) and (024) crystal planes of LSC1, respectively (Figure 1f)

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental mapping validated the homogeneous distribution of La, Sr, C, and Ti elements in LMN.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Elemental mapping validated the homogeneous distribution of all elements (La, Sr, C, and Ti) in the LMN (Figure 1g)

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance (Cdl) values calculated from CV: LMN 6.83 mF cm^-2 (highest ECSA), LSC1/NF 3.50 mF cm^-2, LSC1 2.06 mF cm^-2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Based on the CV curves, the calculated C_dl of the NF, LSC1, LSC1/NF, and LMN were 0.61, 2.06, 3.50, 5.17, and 6.83 mF cm^-2, respectively (Figure 2c)

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS spectra show little difference for C, La, and Ti before and after OER, with slight changes in Co and O spectra and neglectable increase in adsorbed oxygen and Co^3+/Co^2+ ratio.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The phase composition stability of the LMN was also investigated which showed that there was little difference for carbon (C), lanthanum (La), and titanium (Ti) in the X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) spectra of the LMN before and after the OER (Figure S18, Supporting Information)
